blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two students were injured in a stabbing incident involving three learners at the Kalayaan Elementary School in Caloocan City on Wednesday. “We are committed to providing continuous medical, psychosocial, and any other necessary interventions in collaboration with the relevant authorities, with the safety and protection of all students remaining our utmost priority,” the Schools Division Office of Caloocan City said in a statement on Wednesday. Following the incident, the school administration immediately coordinated with barangay officials, local police, and the Department of Social Welfare and Development.
